messages:
morgan: Quick sync — kicking off a Q4 incident trends synthesis. Goal: consolidate recurring patterns across the last 6 postmortems, assign remediation ownership and timelines. Who can own the initial taxonomy?

priya: I can lead the taxonomy. Need the incident exports + labels. @sam can you pull counts and a heatmap?

sam: On it. I'll run the incident-db query and post counts. Query I'll use:
```sql
SELECT incident_id, primary_cause, team, created_at FROM incidents WHERE created_at >= '2025-09-01';
```
Will push CSV + simple pivot by EOD. :eyes: 

devops-bot: Export job queued (job_id: 57ef). ETA ~12m.

ingrid: For KV cache evictions, we should separate LRU tuning from model rollouts. ACTION: ingrid -> propose KV eviction mitigation options (incl. rollback criteria) by 2025-12-15.

lucas: Noted. Also seeing partner-api rate-limits causing >95th pct tail errors. ACTION: lucas -> partner rate-limit analysis + circuit-breaker proposal by 2026-01-05. I'll loop in partner-ops.

priya: High-level themes to track: 1) KV evictions / cache instability, 2) autoscale misconfig under burst traffic, 3) partner-egress/rate-limit fallout, 4) deployment race conditions, 5) disk pressure/resource contention.

sam: Export complete: uploaded CSV (drive.link/placeholder). Quick counts from 2025-09-01..2025-11-25: kv-eviction=18, autoscale-throttle=12, partner-egress=9, deployment-race=6, disk-pressure=4. Also attached small timeline heatmap.

morgan: Good. Priya, can you draft a mapping doc that assigns owners and impact (SLO severity + frequency)? Use the template in #eng-ops (link).

priya: Will draft now. ACTION: priya -> publish taxonomy + owner mapping by 2025-11-28. I'll include KPI columns (repeat-count, median-ttf (time-to-fix), blocker flag).

morgan: For tracking we should create a lightweight kanban board named "Incident Recurring Patterns" and create tickets for each thematic fix. ACTION: morgan -> create board and add tickets by 2025-11-30.

ingrid: For KV evictions, a short list of mitigations I'll evaluate: adjust LRU window, persist cold keys to SSD backing store, and add throttled prefetch on hot paths. Will include perf impact estimates.

sam: Quick win for deployment-race: enable hash-based routing for canaries (reduces sticky collisions). ACTION: sam -> patch infra canary routing and rollout for two most-affected services by 2025-12-01.

devops-bot: Reminder: monthly recurring-incident review scheduled 2025-12-05 16:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent.

lucas: I'll coordinate with partner-ops for a short-term rate-limit increase and long-term circuit-breaker + shed strategy. Pinged @partner-ops in slack.

priya: @morgan can you confirm any SLO adjustments we should tag to the tickets once created?

morgan: Confirmed — add SLO impact column. Also want monthly KPIs: repeat-count per pattern, median time-to-remediate, owner on-time rate. Priya, add KPI columns.

priya: Will add KPI columns and initial baseline numbers from the CSV. Proposing follow-up sync after tickets exist — suggest 2025-12-08 15:00 UTC. :calendar: 

sam: Works for me.

ingrid: +1

lucas: +1

morgan: Thanks all — keeping this thread canonical for follow-ups. Please paste ticket links here when created and update status. :white_check_mark:

devops-bot: Board created: INCIDENT-RECURRING-PATTERNS (board_id: 994). Initial tickets created: IRP-1..IRP-5. Links will be posted when available.
